_doc: Per-sheet period finish for the weapon HD pass (docs/tools/weapon_hd/build_sheets.py). EVERY rule whose regex matches the
lower-case sheet stem is merged over 'default' in list order (later wins), so general rules come first. steel: blued | parkerized | painted. brown: what saturated brown
in the art is - wood | plastic (bakelite / moulded grips) | none (no wood or bakelite on this sheet: dunkelgelb paint,
rust tones). Sources: WWII service finishes - US arms parkerized from ~1941 (Garand, Carbine, M1A1 Thompson, M3,
M1911A1 with brown plastic grips, S&W Victory, Johnson, Springfield 03A3, BAR, M1919); German arms blued or
phosphated, bakelite on MP40 / MG42 / P38 / Tokarev-type grips; British No.4 / Sten / Welrod / PIAT black or green
paint; bazooka OD paint with a wooden shoulder rest; Panzerschreck painted.

protect._doc: UV points (u, v) whose texel must keep the ORIGINAL art colour: a disc (r = 0.006 of the sheet) is exempt from wear, scratches and grime. The ADS agent's added cocking knobs sample ONE texel for all their faces (docs/proposals/ads_bolt_2026-10-04/tools/add_part.py). Old points stay protected alongside the new ones until the ADS agent's mesh change is committed (harmless: a protected disc only keeps the original art).

erase._doc: Source-art regions (u0, v0, u1, v1) erased BEFORE upscaling: each column is filled by linear interpolation between the rows just outside the rect, plus the noise of the rows above it - plain metal, the surrounding light gradient kept. For markings that are not period-plausible (the user's rule: real markings plausible and legible, or left out).

esr._doc: per-sheet Real-ESRGAN weight 0..1 (rest = sharpened Lanczos) for art ESRGAN exaggerates

skip.textures/models/weapons/m1garand/m1clip: today's hd_m3l1a 2048 4x upscale of the same art is cleaner than any rebuild (ESRGAN smears the cartridge brass, QA round 2); kept as is

tame._doc: per-sheet 0..1 compression of bright local streaks on dark art (painted drips that upscale into hallucination-looking blotches)
